notes.title: Version 1.1.3: Bug fixes, and logging disabled
notes.content:
This is a bug fix update that may slightly improve performance. Logging is also disabled by default (it can be enabled by editing config.json).

 Remove all calls to `glGetError`
 Disable logging by defaultThank you for playing Cakefoot! New features are being planned for version 1.2 ːenteringsteamvrː

notes.title: Version 1.1.2: add version string to pause menu
notes.content:
Small update to help identify technical issues ⚙


Add version string to pause menu
Enable vsync
Now you can get the version of Cakefoot from the pause menu by clicking the gear or pressing ESC during gameplay. Contact me at cocktail.frank@dank.game if you are experiencing issues with the game, technical or otherwise, and let me know the version and platform you're using!

notes.title: Update to 1.1.0
notes.content:
Fixes a couple of bugs introduced in 1.0.5.

Prevent the coin HUD from being transformed in the display effects modes.Fix a bug which loaded the wrong level's coin bank status when resuming a game saved at a checkpointFuture updates will use the last digit for bug fixes and minor changes and the second digit for new features or other major updates.

notes.title: Cakefoot officially launches on Steam!
notes.content:
Cakefoot is now available to add to your library! Alongside the Steam launch, version 1.1.0 has been released with improvements to the coin system. It is now easy to tell whether the coin has been collected on each level.
The coin appears above your head after you grab it. It remains there while you are holding it, before it has been added to the bank.
Once you reach a checkpoint or the end of a level, the coin is added to the bank. If you don't make it to the safe point, the coin is given back!
The bank now appears in the HUD, showing clearly which level coins have been collected during a run.
The coin sticking out in the bank indicates which level you are on in the quest and how close you are to the final level.By the way, the coin system is inspired by the strawberries in Celeste. Enjoy Cakefoot on Steam! 🍓

notes.title: Update to corrected Linux build for Ubuntu-18 instead of Debian-Testing
notes.content: This replaces the Linux testing build with the Ubuntu-18 build which has wider compatibility

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 released!
notes.content:
Notable improvements to input support include:
 New dynamic UI that switches between gamepad and mouse modes automatically
Ability to add a gamepad or switch to a different gamepad while the game is running
Support for either D-pad or analog stick
Improved visibility of selected button in gamepad mode
Home button pauses the game before the Steam interface is launchedFurther upgrades for better Steam input support and gamepad customization are planned 😺👍
